note: Custom key store backed by CloudHSM; the XKS option would be outside AWS.
External key store via XKS proxy; low throughput hint addresses XKS latency limits.
AWS managed key cannot be shared cross-account; snapshot must be copied to a CMK. D is not possible in place.
AWS managed key policies can be viewed but not changed, and the keys cannot be scheduled for deletion.
Key policy that names roles is only editable on a customer managed key.
Relies on the recent change that new general purpose buckets block SSE-C by default (BlockedEncryptionTypes); other options clearly wrong. I am less sure of exact API wording.
Snapshot, then create encrypted volume (or copy snapshot with encryption); then swap volumes (not offered).
Disable is reversible with no time limit; scheduled deletion has a limited window.
S3 server access log destination buckets support only SSE-S3 default encryption.
